The '''battle of the Eva-T system''' was a two-stage conflict fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Nami]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after discovering that the Nami had operational [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]].

==Prelude==
After [[Ambush on Hashim|stealing]] one of the Empire's [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] prototypes from the Imperials and, with the help of rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]], [[Battle of Kiilimaar|abducting]] the [[Unidentified TIE Defender chief scientist|Chief Scientist]] of the TIE Defender project, the [[Nami]] leader and [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ali Tarrak]] gained the ability to manufacture and produce her own TIE Defenders. After giving a [[Battle of Yrrna|demonstration]] on an Imperial Cargo area, with a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cruiser as a observer, it became apparent that she intended to profit from this by selling TIE Defenders to various parties, the Rebel Alliance in particular.

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was tasked to counter this threat and had begun his own starfighter ever since the [[Rneekii]] had originally kidnapped the Chief Scientist. Now with the discovery of a Nami [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruiser]] planning to rendezvous with the Rebels to arrange purchase of eight TIE Defenders. Thrawn decided to let the Empire's best [[Imperial Ace]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] test his new project, the [[Missile Boat]], on its first official combat mission.

==The battle==
===First stage===
Two Missile Boats escorted by [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] arrived at the rendezvous site and started engaging the Nami [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]], [[Gorgg Squadron]]. The Strike cruiser ''[[Nuance]]'' launched more T-wings one squadron at a time, while launching three [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] [[Miner group|''Miner'']] to deploy mines around the ship. As the T-wings were taking heavy losses, Rebel [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] ''[[Prism]]'' arrived.

Stele managed to finish off the remaining T-wings and destroyed all three transports deploying mines. He then helped the Assault Gunboats disable the ''Nuance''. Not long afterwards, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Grey Wolf]]'' arrived to deliver an [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|Assault transport]] to board and capture the ''Nuance'', recovering eight TIE Defenders, and with the help of the gunboats destroyed the ''Prism'' before it could retreat into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Stele's sensors picked up a [[Probe droid|probe]] called [[Yey]] nearby and destroyed it. Thrawn would later learn of Tarrak's manufacturing factory where she was building more TIE Defenders. But first he decided to make a stand, knowing that the Rebels wouldn't give up the TIE Defenders without a fight.

===Second stage===
As predicted, the Alliance sent three Carrack cruisers ''[[Kingdom 1|Kingdom]]'' to attack the ''Grey Wolf''. Stele launched from the hanger in a Missile Boat to engage the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] that were attacking the ''Grey Wolf'', followed by engaging the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] as they were finishing off the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]], Stele then had to fend off two [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] squadrons that were also making torpedo runs against the ''Grey Wolf''. The Carrack cruisers finally launched [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], which Maarek Stele also dealt with. He then began launching [[Proton bomb/Legends|space bombs]] at the cruisers. During the run, [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|escort shuttle]] ''[[Black Box]]'' launched from one of the cruisers, carrying Rebel [[Commander/Legends|Commanders]]. Stele inspected and then destroyed the shuttle before it could escape. The cruisers were all destroyed shortly afterwards.

==Aftermath==
The loss of three Carrack cruisers and Commanders was a significant blow to the Rebellion. It also demonstrated the power of the Missile Boat. With the Rebels' defeat, Thrawn set his sights on Tarrak's TIE Defender factory.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in the [[1994]] PC Game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. This is from Battle 10, missions 4 and 5. This article assumes completion of all "Primary," "Secondary" and "Bonus" objectives.
